messages:
carmen: Heads up 1: co-hosted mini-workshop with NebulaPartners Friday 10:30am PT. They want a 25min live integration + 15min Q&A. Can we do a 30m tech dry-run Thurs 4pm PT?

hassan: I'm available Thurs 4pm. I'll verify marketplace provisioning and the subscription webhook flow. Also need to validate tenant-scoped demo token.

tina: I'll handle swag. Order: 100 attendee kits (sticker, lanyard, one tee). Shipping note: 30 kits to UK, need customs paperwork  value $20/kit. I'll upload the pro-forma tonight.

evan: Tech notes: Nebula will call our hosted endpoint and want an on-failover to our dedicated EU pool. Need to test regional routing policy and CORS for their embedded iframe demo. Also confirm redirect URI whitelist.

carmen: Hassan 1 can you paste the redirect URI so I add it to staging allowlist?

hassan: Redirect URI: https://app.nebula.partners/oauth/callback. Adding it now.

tina: Swag courier ETA Fri 8:00am. On-site packing starts 8:30am; need a volunteer for kit QA at 9:15am. Anyone?

evan: I can do QA at 9:15am and I'll run the routing smoke during the dry-run. Quick smoke command for staging:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo-nebula-177123'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"redwood-hosted-stable","prompt":"nebula failover test","max_tokens":12,"simulate_load":true}'
```
Expect initial route to hosted, then fallback to `redwood-dedicated-eu` when simulate_load triggers. Watch `routing-decisions` and `failover-events`.

ops-bot: Dry-run reminder scheduled Thu 16:00 (1771310400). I will ping this channel 15m before. :bell:

carmen: Draft runbook checklist: 1) whitelist redirect URI 2) provision 6-hour demo token 3) verify CORS and iframe load 4) swag manifest + customs uploaded 5) QA volunteer confirmed. If all good by EOD tomorrow we lock the dry-run. Thanks! :tada:
